dialogues.speaker: Scorched Notes
dialogues.text: "...If you're reading this, congratulations! You've fallen foul of a trap set by the Millelith many centuries past, just like I have..."

dialogues.speaker: Scorched Notes
dialogues.text: "...Whatever you do, <color=#00E1FFFF>DO NOT believe</color> a single word of the inscription upon the mechanism..."
